description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question sources within a dataset, showing the proportion contributed by different question answering (QA) sources. The chart contains five slices, each representing a different QA source. The largest slice, labeled “TriviaQA,” is red and represents 46% of the dataset (1829 instances). Next is a purple slice labeled “HalluQA” representing 25% (997 instances), followed by a brown slice labeled “Chinese Domain” representing 18% (721 instances). A green slice labeled “HalluEval” represents 5% (185 instances), and the smallest slice, labeled “HalluQA,” is teal and represents 6% (231 instances). Percentage values and instance counts are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size. A legend is not present, but the labels are directly on the chart.
